title: Super Mario World (Pre-release) - Cheep-Cheep, Monty Mole, Pokey, Sumo Brother and Volcano Lotus
description:
This is a few beta graphics that i found inside the "z-mario-4" folder of the 2020 data leak files (or gigaleak), and i passed a piece of the gfx in the final game.

It includes:
- Cheep Cheep;
- Monty Mole;
- Pokey;
- Sumo Brother;
- Volcano Lotus;

All this GFX uses the palette of the final game.

Does not include:

>Yoshi

>Luigi

>Beta Forest

Credit not needed but appreciated.
